# blur

Gaussian blur with separate X and Y radius controls

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|-----------|------|---------|-------|-------------|
| radiusX | float | 5 | 0-50 | Radius X |
| radiusY | float | 5 | 0-50 | Radius Y |
